text_block_list.text:
Another summer with Супер Крик is
here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's filled with emotion over realizing
how much
I've matured since last year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With a bond so strong you could almost
call it
familial, we look towards the fall
race as our final
summer camp together
begins!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
